title: AFUA NYAMEKYE THE BEAUTIFUL GIRL
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Once upon a time, there lived a girl called Afua Nyamekye who lived with her parent in a village called Asempakura, Kurom. In the village Afua was the most beautiful girl they ever liked. Everyone in the village pampered her very much that Afua felt she is the beautiful girl in the world.

Her parent Mr. and Mrs. Nyamekye pampered her and gave her anything she needs just because she was beautiful. Therefore she didn't respect anyone she knows. She taught she was the queen of Africa. She grew to became a very beautiful lady with a long hair but disrespectful and disobedient. She talked to people disrespectfully and everyone

title: THE THREE FRIENDS
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: In Bipekoko, there lived three friends. They really loved themselves to the extend that they can kill themselves for one another. They were called, Akua, Afia and Adjoa. Their parents were very good friends. Akua was fair and short, Afia was a little bit tall and fair and Adjoa too was a tall and fair girl. They lived in a compound house.

As they grew, they were separated by their schools, but destiny brought them together in college. They all got the same college which they was always praying to get. They hired a room and stayed together. One day as they were going to preps, Afia was called by someone and they left her and went. Afia asked "why are you calling me?" He said "Oh! I wanted to be friends with you, as I saw you I was attracted by the holy spirit and I want you as my friend do you know me am Cafefe, Cafefe, Talatalala, and I have a car with a lot of money, can I get your number?"
Afia was standing still, looked at him and said "I will think of it, you just give me your number" she said laughing. Then the gentleman said "Sure, I will see you".

"Bye" Afia replied. She told her friends about it, and Akua said "that boy that called you, I have been waiting for him to tell me exactly what he said, and I would tell you to be his friend, because he has a lot of money, a whole lot". Adjoa also said "oh please! Akua don't give her bad advice, Afia I will tell you to leave that boy and study hard, I know my mum struggles to get me money to eat, so I really study hard to make her proud, but I know that's not how your parents struggles, they just get it when you asked, Just because they want you to study hard and make them proud". Afia said "eh! I know but I think I must be friends with him, afterall he has money." Adjoa said "oh! I have said what I have to say oh! hm" They all went to bed and slept.

The next morning Afia told the boy that they could be real friends. The boy called out a party outside the school and Afia went to the party, after the party Afia waited and the boy called James gave Afia a drink, she slept off and he raped her.
James ran out of school and went

to where no one can find him. When Afia realise her pregnancy she told her friends and Akua said, "oh Afia sorry, but you had to be more wiser, oh! sorry, sorry". Adjoa said "don't say I didn't warn you, I did my part as a friend". Afia said "oh my friends is this what you will say". Akua said "what now?" Afia said "Abortion" Adjoa said "Abortion no please you will die, please." Afia said "then what?" They all kept quiet and went out to iron their cloths.

Afia was sacked from school and her friends were there. Afia cried but her parents felt very disgrace, disappointed guilty and disappointed. They sent Afia to the village to learn more about life. Afia said to her self "why me, I should have listened to Adjoa, oh God how can I manage living in village", she cried and cried.
Moral: Study hard, be wise and say no to boyfriend relationship.
THE END

title: The Three Rivals.
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Once there lived a man called Papa Gyasi. He had three wifes, they were called; Fatima, Ama and Mina. They was always arguing or fighting over something, but Papa Gyasi didn't care. One day Papa Gyasi called a meeting. He started by; "I know you guys are thinking of why I called this meeting, actually I want to marry Ama, Maame Pokua's daughter". "What" says Fatima.

"Look at Ama, look at how she behave and you want to get another Ama (you)?" Said Mina. Ama also said "oh my husband husband and if you want to marry you can, but why Ama why, don't you like me, Okay oh I have agreed". "Haba" Fatima said.

They all asked "does she have Kids"? Agya said "Yes Four kids" Mina said "Agya why, you know there are five children here and you want to marry and bring another four kids hmm ooi!" Fatima said "Agya you know the children here are so stubborn, they will kill her oh?"
The next day Agya brought the woman and her children, as she opene

ed the living room door, she saw them and started talking; "Oh so is you people that you dont want me okay, I want to make it clear to you that don't interrupt when I am talking, I came to marry, I didn't come for you guys mtcheew". They were all shocked and kept quiet. The next day, when they called the new wife to sweep she said "I did not come for sweeping". Ama said "Oh you didn't come here for sweeping then why are you here, you are here to marry right, okay then you are not going to eat, drink, sleep, talk and more, you are going to marry, Oya pack your things from here and marry nonsense".

As soon as they all went inside and left the new Ama, she heard Agya shouting in the bathroom, Agya said "help me, help me, send me to hospital, my hearth". Ama called the old wives and they sent him to the hospital. As he arrived he said, "you see you guys are always fighting, why won't I get heart attack". They all kneel down and apologize, from there they stayed happily with the nine childre
and the new wife. They no more fought again.
Moral: Have patience because if the first wife did not accept there wouldn't have being a second wife.
The End

title: THE BROTHERS
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: There lived two brothers named Kofi Amponsa and Yaw Amponsa. They lived in a town called Bobrapa. These two brothers were Orphans so they lived with their aunt. They really loved theirselves and they were always adviced by their auntie to study hard.

Kofi Amponsa was dark in complexion with a big mouth and eyes while Yaw was tall and fair with a sexy eye and small mouth. They grew so nice staying with their auntie. When they grew, Kofi became a constructor and Yaw became a doctor. Kofi really envied Yaw because of his work. One day after work Kofi had a bad plan. He taught in his mind; “I must steal all Yaw's money and run away with it”.

The next day when they Yaw went to work, Kofi came back home and started stealing all his money. At that time Yaw forgot his phone at home so he went home. As soon as Kofi opened the door with a sack of money, Yaw saw him and was shocked. Yaw said;
“So is this my return for everything I did for you, for all the advice, for the money the house you are even staying in,” Yaw continued saying
“You are now a thief and a shamours I can't believe you are my brother, I will have to leave you before you kill me”.
“Is the work of the devil brother, please forgive me” Kofi said.
“Please, please I beg you I will never do such things again please you are my brother shame him” Kofi said.
“Ok I have forgiven you stand up and return the money to where you took it, let's go” Yaw replied.

They lived happily again but still Kofi was jealous and thinking about a plan. One day Kofi suggested they should go and spend a holiday abroad. Yaw liked the idea and they started preparing. When they settled Yaw told Kofi that “is no more a holiday we are settling here for feather notice”.
As they stayed there they got married to young and beautiful ladies. But still Kofi envied Yaw, he again taught to himself.
“Oh God which kind of brother is this, when I take dark he will take [illegible] and now I took dark he took fair he has gotten dark with a big butt.

Kofi lied the next day that he was sick and decided to rape his brother's wife. As his wife and brother was not around he went and locked his brother's wife in his room and raped her, covered her mouth and the lady was trying to shout but she couldn't. He called his brother and said “he want to go to a hotel to spend about two or three days” Yaw also said “why”. He said “because I want to enjoy myself (Kakra)”. He cut off the call and went. When Yaw was back he noticed that his wife is pregnant and suspected Kofi because whenever Yaw asks his wife she won't talk because she was frightened. Kofi went back home and was arrested. He begged and begged and begged but Yaw didn't mind him.

After (1) year Yaw and his wife was staying happily with their small baby girl named Fazia, meaning Victorous, Winner and Successful. Yaw and his wife give birth to another two children. As Fazia grew, she became the wife of the Vice president, she made Yaw and his wife very happy. Yaw made the police release Kofi, “afterall he had learnt his lesson.” Yaw said. Yaw showed Kofi his two

children and also introduced Fazia to his real father. They told Kofi everything and he was very ashamed and felt very guilty. One day Kofi went to buy some toiletries found his first wife, they talked and remain silent for a while, then Kofi's first wife taught of killing Kofi because she was a very nice girl when she was not married but since she married Kofi she had changed and because of the raping Kofi did she felt she must do that even not for any reason.
She took a gun and shut Kofi and she was sent to the police station. Yaw made a nice Funeral and he cried so much. Yaw cried Moral. Don't envy someone.
THE End

He had a big mouth and eyes, small nose or pointed nose and a middle class ear. He had a sexy face and a slim body which always was attracting the girls. Brea Adjei even planned to kill him but it didn't work, Frank was a very wise boy. So he caught him red handed when he was putting the poison in his food. title: The Evil Friends
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Asempaniya is a place where three friends Aseda, Alice and Muslima lived. They attended the same school. And they did everything together, they bath together, cook together, eat together and learn together. Their parents were also good friends like Aseda, Alice and Muslima's friendship, they lived in a compound house. In school Muslima was very intelligent and smart. Well, because of that Aseda and Alice envied her. One day Muslima was at school and her friends were also there, their teacher Sir. Ike asked a question, nobody knew the answer to the question but Muslima Did, that day they were really envy, they didn't want her to know that they envy her. Muslima went home and her mother said "Friends are bad, you won't know, what envy they envy you just be careful mm" "oh mum, I think you are referring to my friends but please they are not like that, never and ever, mummy don't worry ah, I want to eat noodles, please just stop thinking negatively ah ah" Muslima said.
The next day the two friends of Muslima decided to introduce Muslima

to deviant behaviour. At first Muslima told them that's not good of them, but as the time was going she became irresponsible girl. Her education started going down and a teacher told her that what's wrong why is she going down, she started insulting. She started playing with boys, to the extend that she could even kiss a boy. She stopped going to school, which means she dressed as a school girl and change herself at somewhere to do prostitution.

One day she was raped by a stranger and went home crying. Her mother said "ah Muslima hmm, so is this what you brought! Pregnancy you, when we talk you don't listen well your Father is coming and I can't afford to tell him, you better tell or go to the village give birth there and come home again". Muslima shouted "I taught my friends are the most best friends in the world, now see, God help me. Muslima decided to take revenge by killing them. She did as was said and was sent to 50 years of imprisonment.
Moral: Some friends are evil.

paragraphs: Emmanuella, shortly or normally known as Ella was the daughter of a rich billionaire. Everyone respected Ella because of his father. Ella was a beautiful girl who was 11 years old. She had a phone, tablet, laptop, computer and a keypad. Two each for all of it. In the girls bank account there was million's of cedis. Their house was a (20) twenty story building which was the most richest house or most nicer house in the country. Only Ella's father was a billionaire in the country. Emmanuella's Father was Frances Burnett Hodgson. Unfortunately for her, her mother passed out when she was giving birth to her. Therefore Hodgson became a single parent. She tried and tried to convince Ella but she couldn't convince her. For about 11 years he was not married because of her

And she will go anywhere with anger. This went on for about 5 years and still Ella was having the same feeling. At that time Ella was (16) sixteen years old. Nearest to finish S.H.S. Then she went home cryed and cryed. Then she was blamed and blamed for she didn't want her father to marry. It was narrated that her father dead of love when she told the woman that she can't marry her, she killed him and was jailed in prison. She was then blamed. After the
funeral she was arrested and jailed for 25 years. At Prison she killed herself and met her father in Heaven.
Hodgson: Oh my! dear!! sorry

title: The Lazy Frog
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Long ago, two frogs were a very good friends, they were called peace and tik. Peace was very hardworking whiles tik was very lazy. Peace always complain to tik but tik always say "And so what, is it your life" And peace will keep quiet. Peace always do the chores in the house whiles tik eat and sleep and watch television.

One day peace was sweeping and heard people saying "please listen everyone the king said tomorrow he has something to tell you so please come there by 6:00 in the evening." Peace asked "please, it something really urgent". He said "please just come there 6:00 in the evening you will know, bye". Peace went to tell tik but tik didn't believe he said "Oh peace, why do you like lieing like this hm". Peace said "me lie, for what Okay if you like believe or not". Peace continued with her chores.

The next day peace cried and did everything fast to go and hear what the king was saying, she tried to convince tik but tik said "I am still thinking if I shall believe". When it was 6:00 peace said "bye tik, am g

ng" tik said "wait for me". When they went the king said "okay my people, I know you guys are thinking why I called for this meeting, actually I want to build a school here and I want everyone to participate because it will bring profit to all of us, you guys can bring anything you think you can use to work and work, that's all I want to say, you can go" tik pace changed.

When they went tik said "am not going". Peace said "please let's go afterall, it's our children that will go to school and bring money when they grow please let's participate". Tik said "okay I will go but I will send the small bucket". Peace said "no, no, no, that's woman's job you should send maybe a shovel". tik agreed. When they went to the place tik was holding a shovel and peace was with a big pan and two big buckets.
The king said "wow!!, wow! so amazing you all participated well lets start, I want to first tell you guys that may God bless you all, for the lazy people that are home they will see what I will do

to them" tik looked at peace face, feeling guilty and happy. The king continued "well the truth is that I'm very happy to see you all because I have already build the school, and I want to give everyone of you money, according to what you brought". Peace looked happy and tik was sad. He said "Oh God how much money will I get with this small shovel, oh I should have stop being lazy oh God". Peace collected so much money whiles tik was sad with the money he got. Peace said "you see, how your laziness have brought you, I can even build a house with the money but you can't even rent an apartment, I hope you have learnt you lesson, lazy frog" tik said "I have really learnt my lesson indeed".
Moral: Be a hardworker, don't be lazy.
The End.

Mrs: "Kofi bye, take care."
Kofi: "mum, dad, bye".
Kofi sat down and taught about what his parent had done, he said to his self "eh so my parents have rejected me, I have to think about what to next to make my grandma proud of me hmm".

The next day, Kofi went to a public school near his grandma's house. The teacher asked a question and pointed Kofi to answer and Kofi had no answer to the question, just then his classmates started mocking him, but because he was smart, he didn't mind. He decided to stop schooling and do another thing. He helped his grandma with farming.

At the age of (14) Fourteen years he had harvested many crops. He sell and give the money to his grandma. One day he had a feeling that he should use his money to buy building materials and try to build a house. After One whole week he was finished and started painting. Then a man walke

with furious to him. The man said "hello, may I know if you are the one who build this house and you did the painting over there, the plastering and everything" Kofi said "yes, please why?" "would you like to be part of Ayoyo buildings, the famous people who build houses in Ghana" The man said. "Yes I will first let me go and tell my grandma" Kofi exclaimed.
Kofi: "Grandma someone want to make me part of the famous Ayoyo ooh".
Nana: "really what are you waiting, pack your luggage and go with him".
"Okay".

The next day Kofi was introduced to the employees and they liked him. Kofi was told they are going to build a house so he joined. One year later Kofi decided to his friends that they should build a hospital since they can build houses for free. They all said "ah, ah are you correct, even the boss have not said this before you that you want to do this, better be careful". He didn't mind but still decided to do.

He started without no one knowing. After (3) three months he told his boss and he was very proud of Kofi. Kofi was crowned the best builder in Ghana on all channels. Mr. and Mrs. Ampong saw Kofi on the television, they taught it was someone till he mentioned his name. They started crying. Kofi was asked what he would say to his parents but and he said "I will thank you all for taking me as your best builder, In life nobody knows tomorrow so just don't juge people, I was neglected by my parents so I stayed with my grandma for seven years, thank you grandma you are the best, you even encouraged me when I lossed hope. For my parents, I have forgiven them thank you everyone".
Kofi Ampong went to his grandma and gave her twenty billion of his money. His parents came to the house crying and apologizing Kofi for what they had done.
Mr: "Please Kofi I beg you in the name of God forgive us, we have learnt our lesson".
Mrs: "Do you know your sisters Ama and [illegible]
are pregnant and at the same time your two brothers have now became thieves and gangsters?"

Kofi: "I have forgiven you dad please stand up, well we learn from our mistakes, mum, dad you see the ones you praised a lot are now useless and I that you rejected me, am now useful anyway please take this money and never think someone is better than one, I have to go bye".
They kept shut with the money and went home. Kofi built another house for them all to stay, Kofi visited them every weekends till the end of his life.
Moral: We are all the same, don't reject human.
THE End

title: The Shoemaker, Agya Prampram.
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Agya Prampram was a shoemaker who lived with his family, he had three children and a wife. Apparently he lived in an uncompleted building given to him by his friend. Agya was a very kind and humble man so everyone liked him. His wife Nana Afunuwaa was also cute and humble. Their children were, Ama, Aseda, and Efua. They were also very lovely except for the troublemaker Ama.

Sufficiently, Agya always work from 6:00 to 6:00 everyday just to eat. He did his best and got his wife a nice shop so he was terrified and happy, at least her wife will work and he will also work so they will get a few money for their children. Because of the schooling of Agya's children, he really worked hard so that his children will become Doctors and Lawyers in future.
One very day Agya started work from 7:00 to 6:00 but technically he got nothing, nobody called him for work, he started becoming worried when it happend twice.
He then decided to let his children stop schooling, after all, school is always there even if they are all old they can go

Agya told his wife but Afunuwaa didn't like the idea he told Agya prampram that he should think twice. Agya taught about it again and told Nana that the children can even sell food near the house and make money for sometime, then return back to school, but this time Nana liked the idea and was perplexed. When they told their children about the idea, Aseda and Afua liked it very much but Ama didn't she told her parent that school is important she can sell things. They tried and tried to convince her but she didn't listen. Ama was with some savings so she went to school with it, after all no school fees.

One day Agya went to work with his tools very happy, just then he was called to repare the shoe, when he was done he collected his money and was about to go, when he saw a brief case, he took it and prayed over it, open it and saw many golds with a passport and other things, Agya was afraid but the first thing he taught was to look for the owner and return it. He walked and walked asking and looking for the owner. It was 6:00

when he saw a bussiness man passing by. Agya fastly asked his name and looked at the passport, unfortunately it was the bussiness man's brief case. Agya told him everything and wanted to go but the man told him to take 50,000 and come to him the next day.
Agya went home with anxiety, told her wife, ate and prayed to sleep for the next day. Nana, and her children were full of splendidness.
The next day Agya went to the man, and this conversation went on;
Agya: "Boss please am here".
Man: "Oh, I thank you very much, you are a very good man, I want to give you a gift please come".
Agya: "yes sir, I will be very pleasant sir".
Man: "this house, this storey building, is now yours, with all the car and everything, if not you that find it and it was anyone I would have being dead by now, thank you again".
Agya: "Oh sir thank you very much am even spe-
echless, thank you ah, thank you very much sir God bless you".

Agya went home told his family and they went to see it, they were very happy and thankfull to their father for his Kindness. Just then they settled and Nana was about to cook when Agya said "what, what do you mean, am coming right now". Nana asked "why my kind husband". Agya replied "I have to go, our daughter Ama had an accident, where is the car key am going". They went to the hospital and saw their troublesome daughter laying on the bed. Ama said with sadness "dad am sorry, I should have listen to you please am sorry". Agya said "Oh my troublesome daughter don't cry or be sorry, everyone had done a mistake before just learn your lesson from your mistake, infact I will have you at your new house next week since the accident was critical." "what new house?" "just wait when you are okay I will tell you".
The next week Ama was out of the

hospital, they narrated everything to her and she was happy, the man, Agya Prampram became a bussiness man, he opened a big storey building shop for his wife and his daughter continued schooling at a popular and private school. They lived happily for-ever.
Moral: Be obedient, kind, respectful and humble don't envy someone. Be good like Agya Prampram. Thanks for reading;
The End.
Look out for many stories from Muslima GH.

title: The Trouble Maker
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Once upon a time, there lived a girl called Ama poma. She lived with her grandmother in a small city. Ama was very troublesome and disrespectful. Because Ama was troublesome her parent sent her to her grandmother to stay with her. Her grandmother complains at everything she do, but she always doesn't mind her grandmother. One very day Ama's grandmother sent her on errand and she said "grandma can't you send these neighbours to go and do that". Her grandmother said "why are you in these house, what do you even do, you just sleep and eat, sleep and eat why, you are here and you want me to send these children, come and take the bucket and go!". Ama replied "I'm not going anywhere, infact I'm going to watch television, just leave me". Ama's grandmother was speechless and went by her self.

Two days later Ama went out and saw her friend's mother very tired and stressful, holding and carrying a big sack, Ama said "Ah, are you not Akua's mother, ah okay so you are the one that have been [illegible] her, just because of somethings she says".

mother said "So you are the one teaching my daughter to be disrespectful, anyway help me am tired". Ama said "are you talking to me, okay is my grandmother you are referring to, me help you, you are sleeping". Akua's mother watched her quietly when she passed behind her without helping. Akua's mother went home, refreshed herself and went to Ama's grandmother to complain. She said to her "I didn't know that's how your granddaughter is, insulting people up and down the road, I am very disappointed in you". Ama's grandma said "please my dear forgive her on behalf of me please, I don't know how to even apologise, please just leave her, or else you shall hear what you have not heard before". Akua's mother went home by saying "Oh, my friend, is okay I have forgiven you, please discipline her very well for me".

When Ama went home, her grandma complained about everything but Ama said "enough with the complains, why, I will kill my self oh!". Her grandma said "rather you kill yourself or not, I don't care anymore, go and pack you things we are going to your mother's house tomorrow, I'm sending you there, I'm tired of
living with you ah, ah!".

When they went Ama's father was dieing and Ama was sent for drugs, Ama saw her friends and started talking about the experience she had, she went home very late and she saw her father died, she taught to herself "what have I done, I should have stop been mischievous and take it serious, oh my God". Ama's mother and grandmother beated her and Ama really regretted. She stopped being mischievous and became respectful, kind, lovely and always serious.
Moral: Don't play with somethings.
The End.

title: The Twins
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Raheema was excited and happy to know that she gave birth to twins. Mr. Bright was also feeling the same as Raheema. They went home with laughter and joy from the hospital, they were welcomed very well and Madam Federa made a nice soup for Raheema to eat and then told her to sleep, while Federa was looking after the children and Bright also giving answers to people's question from home to home. The question was; She gave birth to a male or female.
The next day, they went to the village with their information and stayed there for sometime while the grand mother was teaching how Raheema would take care of the children.

After a week, they went back to the city with Raheema's Mother who was to teach Raheema about how to take care of them since it was her first time giving birth. They bought the children's dresses, shoes, cosmetics, medicines, toiletries and many [illegible]. Raheema's mother went back to the
village when the twins was 1 year. The twins were named Muslima and Muslimat, which Muslima is the youngest and Muslimat is the eldest.

When this twins was two years they started to flex in the community, wearing nice dresses and sandals with their spectacles and bangles with chains. Many adults who were at their dependence age were saying that the children are their wives. At their (2) two years birthday they went to a mall for shopping and bought many things and even bought unuseful or useless things. They eat dinner at a resturant, and swim, they even did some more activities. The next day, they went to Accra to continue the enjoyment and there was the place where the evilness of Muslima came.
She started to hate her with all her might and strenght. The more they grow the more Muslima hate her sister Muslimat. When Muslimat saw that Muslima hate her she got

a plan. Her plan failed and failed but one very and faithful day she passed and they became best-friend, best sisters and best daughters. They grew to became a very nice girls with a nice structure. For Muslima she had a nice coca-cola shape with amazing body parts. She was fair and beautiful she was also always stunning. And for Muslimat she is a little bit like Muslima except her structure and complexion.

When they were 20 years, they were forced to marry by their parents. Unfortunately they got in-love with the same boy. Then the twins did not even envy themselves instead they wanted to even be together because they was always together. Muslima and Muslimat went to the man and told him the truth. They said please, good morning, we are here to tell you something, you know we are twins and we do everything together so we cannot be seperated and I mean Since we cannot be seperated you

will have to marry the two of us, please you have to understand us”. The man was furious and said “am sorry but I think I will have to think about it very well, then I call you back”. He then ran home with anger. The twins, Muslima and Muslimat went home and had patient. After two weeks they couldn't have patient and they went to his house, when they went they saw a party going on there. Just then they saw two ladies coming towards them, they took their hand and was sent to a room. They were dressed and their question to the ladies were; “please why are you doing this who are you”? But they had no answer. Because they was decent they controlled their temper. After (2) two hours they were sent to the party and abrasively they saw Burnett who they were in love with, in a nice coat, nice shoes and a nice trousers and a fine gold chains. They were happy and ran to give Burnett a big or great huge. Muslima on the right and Muslimat on the left. Everyone was clapping for them as they were on stage. Burnett narrated everything and they were all

shocked to hear what happened. Just then they saw their mother and father, [illegible], Burnett parents and the twins parents. Apparently Burnett parent were the one that brought the idea to Burnett and for the twins their parents couldn't have patient and was worried so they went and saw the party. Burnett gave a speech and the twins also did. Burnett father suggested that the party should turn to an Engagement but the girls didn't agree to the idea. They set a date for the wedding and engagement and even continued to party. The twins danced with the boy and his parent and also their parents. Muslimat and her sister and parent were forced to stay at the house till two weeks. The house was nice and everything in it was nice, so they agreed and went for their cloths.
In that two weeks everything changed in the twins Family. Burnett built a house for the Family, they were given two cars and they went for shopping on everything including their cloths and shoes.
Many thanks was from the
family to Burnett Family. After the two weeks they went back and was very happy at the moment. The next three days they had to start with the peperation for the wedding.

“This engagement was very authentic” said Burnett. “Thank you for everything” the twins said. “You are always welcome my dear wives” Burnett said. They all started laughing and Burnett continued “Oh I have remembered something I have to tell you both, please wives, please, I beg you guys, please you know no marriage is perfect and I want you too to love your-selves and I, you know envyiness!!! yeah envyiness is what I'm talking about, everyone is fulled of envy, I mean some times you will feel that I must be given this not you, I must be given the love of Burnett not you, and all that, that's what am saying I mean jealousy, you know many people kill their sisters because of jealousy”. Muslima continued with it “oh dear husband you know I understand you very well it has happened before I hated my sister

to the extend that I did not listen to her if she's talking, but my dear sister got a plan and it worked out for her and now this is us, having each other's back you are shocked right”? “Yeah” Burnett replied.

This conversation took place at the end of the day, which is the night of the engagement. They all slept on a bed which Muslima's head was on Burnett and Muslimat was far far asleep. The next day they woke up early and bathed and dressed for the weeding. The weeding took place in the United State Of America. Only the rich and middle class rich were invited, no poorer people that will eat too much. The pastor was called Apostle John Ofori Atta who was from Nigeria.

The weeding was memorable and fantastic. The pastor said “I give Muslima and Muslimat to you burnett as your wives”, they all clapped and he continued “I give burnett to you Muslima and Muslimat as your husband”. Again they clapped. Then five small or children, wearing
weeding gowns came in and danced a lot of modern dance. Many activities went on and the weeding was really patronising and [illegible].

They went home and started a nice fresh family after the hanni-moon. A lot of visitors or guest were in their house for one week. Muslima and Muslimat will always wake-up early, one cooking and the other sweeping and cleaning. Breakfast will be served as early as 6:00 and they will go and bath and dress to work. Muslima and Muslimat was now owning a great mall and that was their job.

After (2) two years the twins got pregnant and gave birth to triplets. I mean Muslima gave birth to a triplet and same as Muslimat. So now the family was (9) nine and Raheema, and Burnett mother came to their house and looked after the children. The family then turned to a nice house with many children. Muslima and Muslimat gave themselves a huge and Burnett also gave them a huge.
This is the life story of the twins
and I hope you have gotten many lesson from thiss if you don't mind, I will give you the moral lesson. Thanks for reading.
More stories will be coming from me
M3h#orAmericanMama.
The END
Moral Lesson
1. Don't envy someone.
2. Be decent and humble.
3. Respect your parents, friends and anyone.
4. Control your temper.
5. Love your brother or sister as how you love your self and have patient for everything.
Bye!! Thank You!!!!!!!!!!!!For Reading!!

title: The Wicked Stepmother.
author: Muslima Acheampong
paragraphs: Long ago, Rahima and her parent lived happily. One day her father said “I think is time for us to travel”, Rahima mother replied “oh my husband, nowadays I have being having a serious feeling that tells me something is going to happen”. Rahima also said “Mum I have also being feeling like that but mum please don't take it serious, it is just normal please, eh dady please where will we travel to this time”. “I think my sister from my stepmother, she is very caring, and she stays at Accra, I think that's the good place this time.” Her father stated. Rahima's Mother said “well I will try to join you.

The next day they all packed their things for the visit. They settled in their car, ready to go. When the driver was driving, he lost balance and they had an accident. Unfortunately, for them Rahima and her Father survived. They went home and did Rahima's mother's burial. After 2 years, Rahima's father Mr. Abdul Wahab got married to a new lady. Rahima didn't like her but as time goes on she liked her.
One day the lady went to visit a friend, the friend of the lady said “ah, ah Ama

you just live with that man just like that you are not and never going to stay there just like that I tell you, see you are going to collect that man's properties, yes you are going to do that”. “What I can never do that the man loves me, well I will think of it” She exclaimed. “You better do that” The friend replied.

She went home, taught of it and said to herself “is true oh, I have to do something. She went to Mr. Abdul and she tried to convince Abdul, unfortunately she suceeded. She started maltreating Rahima. She starved Rahima, when Abdul was not there. One very day Mr. Abdul had a meeting at U.S.A. He went when Rahima said “dad please, please, I beg you in the name of God”. Mr. Abdul didn't mind her daughter because the love of the lady have blinded him.

That day the lady; Florence sent Rahima to the market, she was about to get an accident, and someone helped her. She went home cooked and served Florence. Florence refused to give Rahima food the whole day. Rahima went to the market and an old man called her “hi little girl, where are your parents why are you roaming up and down”. Rahima started

“my mother is dead and my father is blinded with love”. She started crying. The old man said “sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you please”. Rahima said “is okay”. The man replied “well I can help you, just pack your things and came here.” “Okay” She went and packed her things, but unfortunately for her, the lady which is her stepmother saw her and asked “where are you going”. “I eh, eh, eh am... going to bath” she exclaimed. “Oh, you are going to bath, okay lets go I want to bath you.” Ama replied. She was locked by Ama and Rahima cried and cried.

Unexpectedly her mother, the ghost appeared but Rahima didn't see her, She touched her and open the door. Just then Rahima had a strong feeling to try and open the door, when she tried to it open simply and she didn't care how it open, she just took her belonging and went. The old man was glad to meet her. He introduce Rahima to his two children, Akua and Michealinda. They lived very happily.
The woman didn't care where the girl was, she was even having an affair with a young man. The young man also

convinced Ama, and Ama gave the property documents to the young man. They planned to leave for and go to America. But the young man betrayed Ama, he lied that he was going to take something. When Ama realized her foolishness she cried and cried and cried. Exactly the time she was crying she saw a ghost and run to her room. When she went she saw the ghost there and wanted to run but the door was locked, the ghost said “bring my daughter back to my husband and leave them right away.” She went and looked for Rahima, apologized to her and cooked Rahima's favourite food. She called Mr. Abdul right away and told him everything, she thanked Rahima and was about to live but the ghost appeared and said “please don't live stay with my husband and my daughter, please just don't repeat, or else you will see what you don't like, well you have given the propertys to the young guy so you have to confess, nice doing work with you bye”. She confess and they went to Mr. Abdul and they went to buy another house and lived happily with enthusiament.
The End.
